column1: # NUR038 statement seal — twin value-called statements (the misfire class,
# fixed 2026-08-01). A completed value-called forward collection now SEALS
# (stack-only re-step, the /s word twin), and a reach-read named fn that
# would collect is an arrival BARRIER (committed via commitBarrierForward
# or resolved from the stack), so consecutive dot-access calls each bind
# their own arguments in source order. These rows are the value-returning
# twin-call matrix: semantically green on the interpreter, compile-REFUSED
# on the pre-existing residual-ordering limitation ("dynamic value
# precedes residual args (fn-value-call boundary)") — two dynamic call
# results in one program residual exceed the Stage-1 lowering. Sound
# interpreter fallback (differential-clean). Graduation = the residual
# lowering handling multiple dynamic results, at which point the ledger
# entries delete and the rows move to lang/spec/fn-value.tsv §6.
def f fn [[x:Any] [Any] [x]] end def m {p: f/v} end m.p 5 m.p 7
column3: consecutive Any-param value calls each bind their own arg

column1: def f fn [[x:Any] [Any] [x]] end def m {p: f/v} end m.p 1 m.p 2 m.p 3
column3: three in a row — every window closes at its own statement

column1: def g fn [[a:Any b:Any] [Any] [(a mul 100) add b]] end def m {g: g/v} end m.g 1 2 m.g 3 4
column3: two-arg windows close at their own arity, not at the next call

column1: import module [def p fn [[x:Any] [Any] [x]] export "M" {p: p/v}] end M.p 5 M.p 7
column3: module-export twins seal identically (the original NUR038 shape)

column1: def f fn [[x:Any] [Any] [x]] end def m {p: f/v} end 5 m.p m.p 7
column3: stack form then forward form — the seal is form-agnostic

column1: def f fn [[x:Any] [Any] [x]] end def m {p: f/v} end m.p (1 add 2) m.p 7
column3: a computed first argument still seals before the second call

column1: def m {l: ([x:Any] => [x])} end m.l 5 m.l 7
def f fn [[x:Any] [Any] [x]] end def h fn [[y:Any] [Any] [y]] end def m {p: f/v} end m.p 5 h 7
column3: value call then bare-word call (the word barrier, unchanged)

column1: # The explicit-paren row GRADUATED 2026-08-27 (Stage 3) and now lives in
# lang/spec/fn-value.tsv §6: it compiles natively and answers `5 7` on both
# lanes. Its siblings below still refuse — they are the UNSEALED spellings,
# where the residual really does carry a dynamic value ahead of later args.
def f fn [[x:Any] [Any] [x]] end def m {p: f/v} end m.p 5 end m.p 7
def e fn [[] [Integer] [42] [x:Any] [Any] [x]] end def m {e: e/v} end m.e 5 m.e 7
column3: an arg-bearing overload wins over its 0-arg twin, per statement (the NUR035 guard holds under the seal)
